comment: Temporary npm audit exceptions read by scripts/ci/audit.mjs. Each one must be dev/build tooling only, have no published fix, and expire. Remove an entry as soon as a fixed version is installed; the audit gate fails by itself when a fix is published, when the advisory reaches a production dependency, or after the expiry date.

exceptions.reason: ReDoS in picomatch <= 4.0.7 with no patched release yet. Reached only through build/test tooling (vite, vitest, tailwindcss, chokidar); nothing is shipped to the browser or the Worker.
exceptions.approvedBy: owner (2026-11-18: ignore until there is a fix)
